title: luau mathmatical statements
features:
if ur executor doesn't have luau mathmatical statements then this should fix it 
NOTE: ONLY WORKS WHEN U USE LOADSTRING
example
loadstring(game:HttpGet("linkhere")) -- only works if run some like this or just normal loadstring
script:
local oldstring = loadstring
    getfenv().loadstring = function(code)
    local source = code
    source = source:gsub("(%a+)%s*([%+%-%*/])=%s*", "%1 = %1 %2 ")
    return oldstring(source)
end
-- only works through loadstrings for += and -=
